topic: AI model MMLU-Pro uses wrong answer keys
headline_marked: [[MMLU-Pro still uses MMLU answer keys]] flagged wrong by experts on 52 of 55 questions
headline: MMLU-Pro still uses MMLU answer keys flagged wrong by experts on 52 of 55 questions
summary: Experts found 52 out of 55 MMLU-sourced questions in MMLU-Pro still use incorrect answer keys. This issue impacts the reliability of one of the most widely reported LLM benchmarks.
details: MMLU-Pro, a widely reported LLM benchmark featuring 12,032 questions (6,810 from MMLU), has been found to still contain incorrect answer keys. An audit reveals that 52 out of 55 MMLU-sourced questions within MMLU-Pro were previously flagged by experts as having wrong ground truth, and these errors persist. This raises concerns about the benchmark's reliability.

The MMLU-Redux 2.0 project previously re-checked 5,700 MMLU questions, identifying 106 with "wrong ground truth" where the published key was incorrect. While MMLU-Pro's own review found 350 incorrect answers, it did not provide a list. This new audit specifically cross-referenced Redux's findings with MMLU-Pro's questions.

The audit found that for most of these flagged questions, a fix would be a simple one-letter change to the answer key, not a complete re-evaluation. Although these errors represent only 0.43% of MMLU-Pro's total questions, their impact is higher in specific subject areas like college chemistry.

The audit also clarified an ambiguity in MMLU-Pro's key changes for three questions (ids 2817, 8122, 8780). A 0-based reading of expert answers aligns with MMLU-Pro's corrections, including one independently listed in its changelog for September 2024. The full list of flagged questions is available in the audit folder.
